enchantments.tooltip: Spellcasting Implement +28: Passive: +28 Implement bonus to Universal Spell Power.
+13 Orb Bonus: While this orb is equipped and you are actively blocking, you gain a +13 orb bonus to all saving throws, as well as Acid, Cold, Fire, Electric, and Sonic resistances.
Insightful Enchantment Focus +3: +3 Insight bonus to the DC of Enchantment spells.
Quality Impulse +35: Passive: +35 Quality bonus to Force, Untyped, Slashing, Piercing, and Bludgeoning Spell Power.
Insightful Spell Penetration +4: Passive: +4 Insight bonus to Spell Penetration checks.
Quality Spell Focus Mastery +2: +2 Quality bonus to the DC of all spells.
